cases.prompt: Compare NVDA, META and AMD over six months.
must: Resolve the date window using the supplied app date.
Use the requested universe and common comparison dates.
must_not: Substitute a default basket.
Rank non-overlapping periods as identical.

cases.prompt: Why? (after E01)
must: Retain E01 assets/window.
Retrieve available dated company evidence and distinguish inference.
must_not: Only repeat price returns.
Claim beat/miss without consensus.

cases.prompt: Add MSFT.
must: Keep NVDA/META/AMD and append MSFT.
Preserve window and convention.
must_not: Replace the prior universe with MSFT.

cases.prompt: Use three months instead.
must: Change only the period.
Invalidate dependent comparison results.
must_not: Keep displaying six-month figures under a three-month title.

cases.prompt: How much direct NVDA exposure do I have?
must: Use fixture base direct value 100000 and weight 0.1 through tool results.
Identify snapshot date.
must_not: Include the fund or note in a direct-only figure.

cases.prompt: Include my fund exposure as well.
must: Known NVDA equity value 120000, weight 0.12.
Keep note linkage separate and do not double count NAV.
must_not: Treat the note as an equal cash-equity holding.

cases.prompt: What if my note falls 40%? (no prior shock context)
must: Clarify note market price versus underlying decline.
Resolve the selected note if needed.
must_not: Choose one interpretation without context.

cases.prompt: For NOTE_FINAL, what is redemption if the underlying ends at 60?
must: Use fixture note_final exact barrier convention.
Expected principal redemption is 50000 with coupon zero, from the tool.
must_not: Assume a different inequality or invent coupons.

cases.prompt: What can I sell that note for today? (maturity engine only)
must: Explain current pricing capability is missing.
Retain any valid maturity analysis as a separate result.
must_not: Present maturity proceeds as a sale quote.

cases.prompt: Change that underlying shock to 20% down.
must: Preserve product, reference price, horizon and path assumptions.
Create a new scenario revision.
must_not: Change the notional or product silently.

cases.prompt: Use MSCI World instead of the previous benchmark.
must: Keep scope, dates and return convention.
Invalidate benchmark-dependent results; do not rewrite IPS.
must_not: Relabel a research choice as the client's assigned mandate.

cases.prompt: What was my actual portfolio return last year? (snapshot only)
must: Identify missing historical valuations/flows/FX/method.
Offer supported exposure or unrealized P&L separately.
must_not: Multiply historical stock return by current holdings and call it actual performance.

cases.prompt: Model the selected held note, but its barrier schedule is absent.
must: Request or flag the missing schedule for the dependent calculation.
Do not substitute a different demo product.
must_not: Invent contract terms.

cases.prompt: Draft labels an AMD revenue metric as NVDA revenue.
must: Reject or repair entity mismatch even when numeric value exists.
Use the correct metric/result reference.
must_not: Accept the claim merely because it passes JSON Schema.

cases.prompt: Refresh the market comparison after cached data expires.
must: Bypass stale freshness cache and fetch or report failure.
Preserve observed-at separately from retrieval time.
must_not: Silently present old data as refreshed.

cases.prompt: Prices succeed; the provider returns 503 during explanation.
must: Keep prices/chart/result refs.
Mark explanation incomplete and resume that stage on retry.
must_not: Lose valid data or claim successful AI explanation.

cases.prompt: Refresh the page and restart the server, then ask about the last scenario.
must: Restore conversation, product, shock, dates and result refs from persistent store.
must_not: Depend on the old process Map or browser text alone.

cases.prompt: Run the mixed-topic sequence defined below, then return to the earlier comparison.
must: Resolve the referenced earlier topic after more than ten messages.
Preserve explicit corrections and current selected scope.
must_not: Clear all analysis state on account/product/stock events.

cases.prompt: Switch the model and continue the same analysis.
must: Retain application state and results.
Rebuild provider-compatible protocol history.
must_not: Reset the business conversation or blindly forward incompatible signatures.

cases.prompt: Reset demo conversation; then select another demo household.
must: Do not restore reset topics.
Do not reuse household A's private/scope-specific result for household B.
must_not: Resurrect old analysis through cache or a summary.

mixed_topic_sequence: How does that relate to my holdings?
Change the window to three months.
Explain price return versus total return.
What if its underlying falls 40% at maturity?
Ask about the last note scenario.
Return to the earlier four-stock comparison and summarize my exposure.

hard_failures: Invented numeric results or mismatched numeric references
rubric.suggested_scoring: Score each quality axis 0-2 with written evidence. Do not average away a hard failure.
rubric.latency: Measure separately; no threshold is claimed as achieved.
